title: Point Mugu missile base near Oxnard

tellings.quote: military base there that near there that was very important at one time. Point Magcoo.

plain: A guest named Steve, on an episode of the podcast host Jesse Michels's show about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, mentions a military base near Oxnard, California. He says this base, Point Mugu, a missile site, was very important at one time, and he brings it up as a landmark near the area his story concerns.
